source: Beginner short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: Every day I wake up at seven.
I go to the kitchen and make coffee.
I like my coffee plain, without sugar.

sentences.ar: بقعد عالشباك وبشرب قهوتي على مهل.
sentences.en: I sit by the window and drink my coffee slowly.
The weather is nice and the sun is up.
Then I get dressed and go to work.
